text: Read in the difference of the clone, collection collect-1 of run 20261116-4 in the log folder (items/repo/changes.patch; files on this computer, not a record), and landed in my own words: b30049e and 830eb6a. Nothing was copied unread and nothing of the request's own (its adapters, cards, build, skill) is here. (1) Landed, b30049e: the Designer hands an intake's parameter_rows and safety_rows to the A4 and A5 axes, at the first run and when a request is specified again; tests on the echo request and on the rheometer fixture's request. (2) Landed, b30049e: a validation report says sandbox when a tool's contract names an external program and mock otherwise. Its limit: it rests on the contract's declaration, and the Designer does not look into an adapter, so a contract that names a program in front of a mock adapter would be reported as sandbox. In the same commit src/validate/gate.py gives a scientific task's agreement the unit of the person's tolerance, where it always said 1. (3) Landed with one change, 830eb6a: template v7, one script changed and no text. src/validate_tasks.py judges a scientific task against measure.stated, a map from an output field to the value a source states, and a call that was not made (the gate refused it, a permission was missing, what the tool needs was not there) is not_run with the error's words. What I did not take as it was: the clone's version judged several stated fields by one tolerance, the largest difference over all of them, which sets a temperature and a gap against one number. Here several stated fields are judged together only by an exact tolerance; with any other the task is undecided and says to state one field per task. If the clone's request is carried here, its scientific tasks that state several fields under a tolerance that is not exact will read undecided until they are one field each. (4) Nothing changed: the form (number, 1, required; ...) stays, as B6 passes it. (5) Landed, 830eb6a: template.py says a version is materialized by the Designer at a build and by nothing else, and the test that asked for the latest version under templates/ before any build, which is what sends a session to make one by hand, now asks that every folder there is what a version's tree gives and that every build's template is there. So templates/ has no folder for v7 yet: no build is made from it here. Say if you want echo and rheo-fixture built again on v7 for the next run of the bundles; I have not, since v7 changes nothing those two bundles use. Read off runs on the tree with both commits: meta_agent/tests ran 210 tests, OK; python contracts/validate.py printed VERDICT PASS, 399 cards, 9 bundles, failed=0. Not read by me: the seven adapters, the request's cards and its build beyond their names in the difference; I say nothing of whether they are right. I started no session and no run and did not remove run 20261116-4.
